name: colibri
description: Run frontier MoE models on hardware you already own — pure C, zero deps, experts streamed from disk. Tiny engine, immense model. 🐦
one_liner: Runs enormous AI models on an ordinary gaming PC by streaming the parts it needs from disk instead of requiring a huge GPU to hold the whole thing in memory.
buyer: A privacy-conscious small business or power user who wants to run a frontier-scale AI model locally without buying tens of thousands of dollars of GPU hardware.
business_use_cases: A small business runs a large local model for internal document Q&A so sensitive files never touch a cloud API.
A developer-tools reseller sells pre-configured 'run any big model at home' PCs with colibri installed.
A hobbyist builds and sells a simple chat front-end on top of it for people who want ChatGPT-class answers fully offline.

money_ideas.idea: Sell preconfigured local-AI hardware bundles with the engine pre-installed and tuned.
A paid setup/support service for non-technical buyers who want it running but can't do the CLI setup themselves.

steal_this: Offer a cheap 'we'll set this up on your machine over a screen share' service to the large audience of enthusiasts who want this running but are intimidated by the command line.
